labels: ""

## Target
Which component, policy, fixture, or protocol are you reviewing?

## Accessibility concern
Describe the issue from the perspective of actual user interaction, assistive technology, WCAG, motion, contrast, keyboard access, text alternatives, or cognitive load.

## Reproduction / evidence
Provide the smallest safe example or test.

## AML declaration vs actual behavior
Does the declared AML metadata appear inconsistent with the rendered behavior?

## Suggested test
What automated or manual verification should be added?

AML accessibility tooling is an additional accountability layer and does not replace WCAG conformance or assistive-technology testing.
